summary: flat creates a new array by expanding nested arrays up to a specified depth.
documentation: flat creates a new array by expanding nested arrays up to a specified depth. The default removes one level, so deeper arrays remain nested. Ordinary non-array values are retained.
caution: It is not recursive by default. Sparse-array holes can disappear; JSON arrays used here have explicit elements.
scenarios: Combine arrays of stop IDs collected from several routes.
Merge one level of grouped form-validation messages.
Collect product IDs from per-order item lists.
title: Flatten one grouping level
problem: Input is a JSON array. Flatten exactly one level of nested arrays, preserving order and all non-array values. Deeper arrays must remain arrays. Do not discard null, false or zero.
goal: Use Array.flat() or an equivalent approach demonstrating the same premise.
hint: Use the default depth of one.
